paragrafos: I overthink things, and sometimes that pays off. I value my friendships a lot, even though some days I'm terrible at being social. With people, I try to be level headed and good humored, and I like them to feel at ease around me. Sometimes I even try to be someone I'm not, but I always end up coming back to myself. When things get complicated, I try to ease the tension so there's still room to talk.

I love the art I find in music, films, games and books. Traveling and being close to nature get me out of the routine and do me good. Those are the moments that remind me what it is to be human, and that make me care more about the place we live in.
I want to build my career in initiatives that care about people's well-being, and to put my effort into projects that fight inequality and environmental problems.

I want to grow as a developer who works alongside AI, learning from it and building better solutions. I'm interested in understanding what a project needs and thinking the system through from its conception. I also want to better understand the environmental impact of this technology and help it evolve with that in mind.
I value solidarity and try to help whoever needs it. Right now that care shows up mostly with the people close to me, and I want to extend it beyond my own circle.

I care about the consequences of my choices, even the small ones that can harm the environment. I want the world to stay a good place to live, and I mean to bring that concern into the projects I take part in. As I grow in my career and have more say in decisions, I want my responsibility toward people and the environment to grow with it.

lista.texto: A gamified, accessible physiotherapy platform that follows the patient outside the clinic. As Scrum Master, I led the team through requirements elicitation and the backlog, and set the scope of each sprint. I also worked as a full-stack developer: I did the design and much of the implementation of the front end and the back end, and modeled the data the platform runs on.
